title: Turkish Lamb Koftas
description: Delicious Turkish-style lamb koftas, flavored with traditional spices and baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, onion, garlic, oats, spice mix, salt, and pepper. Mix well with hands until just combined.
Thread lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each kofta.
Place skewers on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, drizzle with olive oil and spread out in a single layer.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through to an internal temperature of 63°C (145°F).
While koftas are baking, brush yellow peppers with a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the peppers are tender and slightly charred.
Serve koftas with roasted yellow peppers and your choice of sides.
